General engineering controls
Laboratory airflow is negative to general
occupancy, corridor and office areas ..... \x01\x01\x01
Cup sinks or drains acting as vents ............ \x01\x01\x01
Sink available for hand-washing ................. \x01\x01\x01
Exposed machine parts (pulleys, gears) ..... \x01\x01\x01
Vacuum line has filters and traps on
laboratory benches ................................ \x01\x01\x01
Backflow hazards to water supply .............. \x01\x01\x01
Distilled water systems in good condition .. \x01\x01\x01
Active and effective arthropod and rodent
control programme ................................ \x01\x01\x01
General practices and procedures
Food for human consumption stored
outside the laboratory ............................ \x01\x01\x01
Microwave oven(s) clearly labelled “No
Food Preparation, Laboratory Use Only” \x01\x01\x01
Eating, drinking, smoking and/or applying
of cosmetics occurring in the laboratory \x01\x01\x01
Pressurized glass containers taped or
shielded (i.e. vacuum traps) .................. \x01\x01\x01
Mouth pipetting prohibited ......................... \x01\x01\x01
Mechanical pipetting devices available
and used ................................................. \x01\x01\x01
Protective laboratory clothing stored
separately from street clothing .............. \x01\x01\x01
General laboratory housekeeping
Glass containers stored on the floor........... \x01\x01\x01
Trip hazards evident .................................... \x01\x01\x01
Clean absorbent pads on work surfaces ..... \x01\x01\x01
Broken glassware handled by mechanical
means (brush and dustpan, tongs, etc.) \x01\x01\x01
Fire protection
Sprinkler heads free and unobstructed ....... \x01\x01\x01
Open penetrations in walls, ceiling, floor, etc. \x01\x01\x01
Wiring or tubing through door openings .... \x01\x01\x01
Minimum passage width of 1 m in laboratory \x01\x01\x01
Storage observed on ductwork or light fixtures \x01\x01\x01
Excess combustibles stored in laboratory .. \x01\x01\x01
Heated constant temperature baths
Equipped with low water level and
overheat shutoff ..................................... \x01\x01\x01
Constructed of noncombustible materials .. \x01\x01\x01

appropriate immunizations/tests for

first aid ................................................... \x01\x01\x01

Facility
Laboratory separated from unrestricted
traffic flow in building ............................ \x01\x01\x01

directional airflow available .................... \x01\x01\x01
Personal protection
Closed-front gowns worn in laboratory ...... \x01\x01\x01

automatically controlled ......................... \x01\x01\x01
Hand protection
Double gloves worn when handling infectious
material, potentially contaminated
equipment and work surfaces ................ \x01\x01\x01
Respiratory protection
Respiratory protection worn by all personnel
in the laboratory when aerosols are not
safely contained in a BSC....................... \x01\x01\x01
Practices

when working with infectious material
outside a BSC ......................................... \x01\x01\x01

training for procedural changes ............. \x01\x01\x01
